subject: counseling
intro: Counselling leads to the licensed work of helping people change — in schools, clinics, families and rehabilitation services — wherever a trained therapeutic relationship is the treatment itself.

roles.title: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
roles.what: Guide students and job-changers through decisions: assess strengths and interests, teach study and social skills, intervene when school life goes wrong, and plan the routes from coursework into careers and further study.
roles.where: Unit 7's career development theories, work–life transitions and career assessment, plus the microskills and alliance training of unit 4, are the professional core of this role.

roles.title: Marriage and Family Therapists
roles.what: Treat couples and families as systems: help members talk through conflict, address how individual distress is entangled with relationships, and bring evidence-based approaches to problems from parenting to separation.
roles.where: Unit 2's postmodern and systemic approaches, unit 4's therapeutic-alliance work and unit 5's group dynamics give exactly the relational craft this licence practises.

roles.title: Rehabilitation Counselors
roles.what: Help people with disabilities live and work independently: assess capabilities and limits, plan for jobs and training, coordinate medical and community services, and advocate with employers and agencies on clients' behalf.
roles.where: Unit 3's multicultural and anti-oppressive stance, unit 7's work–life transition theories and unit 8's trauma-informed care ground the adjustment-to-disability work this role does.

roles.title: Mental Health Counselors
roles.entry: Bachelor's degree; licensure for mental health practice
roles.what: Treat mental and emotional health problems: assess and diagnose clients, deliver talk therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma and addiction, run prevention programmes, and coordinate care with psychiatrists and social services.
roles.where: Unit 6's clinical interviewing and DSM diagnosis, unit 8's evidence-based treatments, substance-use and trauma-informed topics, and the CBT content of unit 2 are this job's daily material.
